en_title: GTA 6 Will Never Get a 60fps Update on PlayStation Pro as It's 'Not Powerful Enough'
cn_title: 《GTA6》永远不会在PlayStation Pro上获得60fps更新，因为它「性能不够强大」
opus_summary: Rockstar技术制作总监Marc Chambers表示，PS5 Pro的处理器性能不足以让《GTA6》的复杂模拟以更高帧率运行。游戏在所有支持的主机平台上均以30帧为目标，PS5 Pro版则提供光线追踪阴影和PSSR等画面增强。

paragraphs.en: There's bad news for any GTA 6 fans still hoping for a 60fps option on PlayStation 5 Pro.
paragraphs.cn: 对于仍希望《GTA6》在PS5 Pro上提供60fps选项的粉丝来说，有个坏消息。

paragraphs.en: While Sony's beefier PS5 is arguably the most powerful console on the market today, even it is unable to run Rockstar's new masterpiece at 60fps. That's according to the game's technology production director Marc Chambers, who admitted that the PS5 Pro could only do so much.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管索尼性能更强的PS5或许是当今市面上最强大的游戏主机，但即便是它也无法以60fps运行Rockstar的新作。这是该游戏技术制作总监Marc Chambers的说法，他承认PS5 Pro的能力也有极限。

paragraphs.en: Somewhat controversially, GTA 6 targets 30fps across all of its supported console platforms, with the same rate on everything from the under-powered Xbox Series S all the way up to PS5 Pro.
paragraphs.cn: 有些争议的是，《GTA6》在所有支持的主机平台上都以30fps为目标，从性能较弱的XBOX Series S到PS5 Pro，帧率都一样。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, there are other differences — and the game's PS5 Pro version has a few extra bells and whistles. But anyone expecting a better frame rate will need to temper their expectations — at least, perhaps, until the game's PC version arrives.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，还有其他区别——游戏的PS5 Pro版本多了一些额外功能。但期待更高帧率的玩家需要降低预期——或许至少要等到游戏的PC版推出。

paragraphs.en: "While the PS5 Pro's central processor is slightly better than the PS5 base console, it is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates," Chambers told Kotaku .
paragraphs.cn: Chambers告诉Kotaku：「虽然PS5 Pro的中央处理器比基础款PS5主机稍好一些，但它的性能还不足以让游戏中复杂的模拟以更高帧率运行。」

paragraphs.en: That said, PS5 Pro still offers other improvements, he continued. "Our base presentation makes use of ray-traced reflections and global illumination," Chambers noted. "On the PS5 Pro, this is enhanced with the addition of ray-traced shadows, as well as overall added clarity through the use of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR). The PS5 Pro features an upgraded graphics processor and upscaling technology that we leverage to increase the game's visual fidelity."
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，他接着表示，PS5 Pro仍提供了其他改进。Chambers指出：「我们的基础画面表现使用了光线追踪反射和全局光照。在PS5 Pro上，我们加入了光线追踪阴影，并通过使用PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution（PSSR）提高了整体清晰度，从而增强了画面表现。PS5 Pro配备了升级后的图形处理器和超分辨率技术，我们利用这些来提高游戏的视觉保真度。」

paragraphs.en: Speaking to IGN, Rockstar's co-studio head and head of development Rob Nelson said that "too much" of GTA 6 would have to fundamentally change for the game to target 60fps. "Too much, too much," he said in our big GTA 6 interview that went live today . "It wouldn’t have been acceptable to anybody. The simple answer is, when you ask the technical team, they're, like, 'Have you seen it?' There’s too many compromises that would've had to have been made to do that, is the short answer."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar联合工作室负责人兼开发主管Rob Nelson在接受IGN采访时表示，如果要让《GTA6》以60fps为目标，游戏中「太多」内容都必须从根本上改变。「太多了，太多了。」他在我们今天发布的《GTA6》大型采访中说道，「那是谁都无法接受的。简单来说，当你问技术团队时，他们的反应就像是：『你看过这游戏吗？』简短的回答就是，要做到这一点，必须作出太多妥协。」

paragraphs.en: Today also brings more detail on how GTA 6 fares while running on Xbox Series S , where it is one of the first games to use AMD's FSR 4.1 on Xbox to upscale the graphically demanding game from 720p to 1080p.
paragraphs.cn: 今天还公布了《GTA6》在XBOX Series S上运行表现的更多细节。它是首批在XBOX上使用AMD FSR 4.1的游戏之一，借助该技术将这款画面要求很高的游戏从720p提升至1080p。

paragraphs.en: IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
paragraphs.cn: IGN提供了《GTA6》发售时你需要的一切信息，包括《GTA6》的全球发售时间，以及你需要下载的临近发售前PS5更新的详情。如果你错过了，昨晚我们还获悉了《GTA6》中Lucia的现实身份。我们的《GTA6》发售博客现已上线，接下来几个小时里，我们将在其中为你介绍有关游戏的其他一切信息。
